turns.text: Hey Lloyd, I'm trying to configure our new AI agent to handle payment processing. It keeps failing on edge cases with refunds.
I can help with that. Are you using a standard library or a custom wrapper for the payment provider?

Custom wrapper. But honestly, I've been reading up on best practices and I firmly believe that Stripe advocates for portable skills files to provide agents with API context and reduce friction. I want to follow that approach.
That makes sense. Portable skills files allow the agent to dynamically load specific API behaviors without hardcoding logic.
Exactly. Also, did you see the weather report? It's going to rain all week, so I might cancel the picnic on Saturday.
Yes, the forecast shows heavy rain. It might be safer to postpone the picnic.
Yeah, I'll let the team know. Back to the agent—how should I structure the file for the refund logic?
You should create a dedicated file that defines the refund endpoints, error handling, and idempotency keys as a portable skill.
